name: Rainleaf Guard
description: Hold a broad dripping leaf of qi before the chest that sheds a blow like rain.

name: Dewlash
description: Flick a vine heavy with dew qi across the opponent's guard so it stings and soaks.

name: Mistleaf Step
description: Slip aside in a haze of mist and leaves and reappear a pace away.

name: Rainthorn
description: Cast a shower of thorns wet with qi that sting like driven rain.

name: Drizzle Bind
description: Let a fine drizzle of qi soak the opponent while sprouts tie them down.

name: Raindrop Mend
description: Let drops of rain qi fall on an ally's wounds and swell the cells to close them.

name: Flood Vine
description: Surge vines on a rush of water that sweep up the opponent and bind them tight.

name: Rainbloom
description: Open a rain-fed bloom over allies that drips healing water on every wound beneath it.

name: Downpour Bough
description: Bring a great bough and a heavy downpour down together across a wide front.

name: Verdant Deluge
description: streams: Wood + Water; Raise a flood and a surge of growth as one so vines and water crush the whole field.

name: Ember Twig
description: Touch a smouldering twig of qi to the opponent's arm so it burns and stings.

name: Charwood Guard
description: Cover the forearm in blackened charwood qi that hardens and does not catch.

name: Kindle Step
description: Push off from a small flare of heat at the heel and burst a pace aside.

name: Torch Bough
description: Swing a flaming bough of qi across the opponent's guard.

name: Charsmoke Veil
description: Raise a thick veil of smoke from a burning limb of qi that hides the user.

name: Warm Resin
description: Spread warm resin qi over an ally's wound so it seals under gentle heat.

name: Kindling Storm
description: Spit a storm of burning twigs that sets everything in a wide front alight.

name: Charbark Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of charred bark that burns off the blows and the fire alike.

name: Pyre Bough
description: Bring down a bough wrapped in roaring flame onto the opponent's guard and body.

name: Pyreblossom
description: streams: Wood + Fire; Open a bloom of living flame whose petals burn and grow back as quickly as they fall.

name: Lifevine Lash
description: Whip a vine alive with life qi across the opponent's arm.

name: Quickening Bark
description: Draw a bark of living qi over the skin that mends itself as it is struck.

name: Lifeleaf Mend
description: Rest a leaf of living qi on an ally's wound until the flesh grows back.

name: Lifebud
description: Plant a bud of living qi in an ally's chest that opens into a steady strength.

name: Evergreen Thorn
description: Spear a living thorn that keeps growing for a breath after it has pierced.

name: Greenlife Draw
description: Draw living qi up from the roots and pour it into an ally's deepest wounds.

name: Lifeblood Purge
description: Flush an ally's blood with living sap until poison and backlash wash clear.

name: Lifetree Cradle
description: Raise a tree of living qi over a gravely hurt ally that feeds sap into every wound.

name: Verdant Revival
description: Pour the full force of living qi into a person whose life has just failed to call them back.

name: Everlife Crown
description: Crown allies with a canopy of living qi that heals every wound under it for many breaths.

name: Genesis Tree
description: streams: Wood + Life; Raise a tree of pure living qi that grows wounds shut and rebuilds the broken around it.

name: Stonebark Fist
description: Punch with a fist sheathed in bark as hard as stone.

name: Flintleaf
description: Hold a broad leaf of qi hardened to granite before the chest.

name: Clay Step
description: Press into the soft ground and push off a heavy pace aside.

name: Rootstone Slam
description: Heave a stone held in a net of roots and slam it into the opponent.

name: Clay Bind
description: Rise clay and roots about the opponent's legs and set them hard.

name: Loam Mend
description: Pack rich loam qi against an ally's wound to feed and close it.

name: Fault Root
description: Crack the ground with a mass of heaving roots that tears across a wide front.

name: Stonewood Mantle
description: Cloak the body in stone-hard wood that no edge can bite.

name: Quakeroot
description: Wrench a web of roots through the ground so the earth itself heaves and breaks.

name: Stoneroot Colossus
description: streams: Wood + Earth; Raise a giant of stone and root that stands and crushes at the user's will.
